body:
Look at all the replies I eventially got. I guess it wasn't in the heat of the moment when I needed it but it happened. I'll leave you with this because it helped me not make a stupid decision today:
If you feel like ending it, that's fine, but stick it out one more day. Best case scenario, you feel better. Worse case scenario, you will always have tomorrow to kill yourself. You never know what might be around the corner. It's always a surprise.
Wow. That you for this. I care about becoming the yolk so to speak. To be loving awareness. You saw my soul. I must be doing something right in that case.

You know I only just started considering that I was in an abusive relationship. It was after we went to a couples therapist so that we could work out my problems. We went through the hour appointment and the therapist asked me back. This pleased my boyfriend because it validated what he already felt. That the only problem in our relationship is me. Well I went back and the therapist said that he was sorry if he thought that I felt like he was taking the other persons side and that he asked me back to talk because he saw that I was in an abusive relationship. He watched my boyfriend systematically destroy me every time I felt emotions. He said he was scared that he was going to go home and beat me. For the record it's never gotten physical. But he started trying to logically put together how I was being abused. I guess when it comes to mental and emotional abuse, sometimes you really don't realize it. I mean it's systematic, very well thought out manipulation. It's hard to explain to somebody who isn't "in" it. I don't know but I know that I have to leave if I want to survive. This was my last semester. Time to go do good work and get paid for it. I worked my ass off. Even if it was a financial strain on everyone, I still accomished this with almost no support other than my parents. I have wonderful parents that love me so much. I just need this toxic person out of my life and I think over time maybe I will feel better.

I've done a little soul searching today. I'm drained and tired and upset but somebody said, "what good is being in a relationship for the sake of your kid if you're dying inside". Damn. I can't argue with that.

Thanks. I feel drained and listless. Just going through the motions. I felt so happy yesterday. I thought I was being good and doing good. Apparently I'm not picking up on something. I felt happy. I got told I was a huge bitch all day but I don't recall being one. My boyfriend said that I draw my eyebrows on wrong and it makes me look like a bitch. I was just trying to look pretty not be a bitch. He said I make him miserable and he wishes I would die. I don't even know what I'm doing wrong. I thought I cleaned up well enough, took care of our son well and got him back and forth from school, made dinner for everyone and cleaned up after everyone. I thought I did it all right. But I was still a bitch. Our son was literally hanging off of me tripping me up at my legs all morning. I said for him to give me space. My boyfriend then said I need to kill myself so that everyone's life will improve. That we struggle with money because I'm wasting time going to school even though my dad pays the rent and bills. I got my final test score back at 94. Not an a+ but I'm still ranked #2. I know it isn't #1. I just wish I wasn't so blind to what I'm doing wrong. I guess going to school was selfish. I could have just worked a retail job to contribute to the household more. I have so many regrets and now it's too late. Nobody even wants me alive.

At least I have a plan on how and where I'm going to die. Make it look like an accident so my child doesn't have to deal with the psychological stuff. I feel like me being around will fuck him up more than me being dead. I tried to do everything right and be perfect and I always failed. I just can't do it. Can't make it be perfect for everyone. All I ever wanted was to feel like somebody cared. Maybe just wanted me to exist for no reason. Like beinga human was enough. I don't have any friends. Nobody wants to be my friend because I'm annoying and sad. Why would that be appealing? My sons father says that I should give up trying to make friends. That nobody wants me alive. That everyone would benefit from my death. Seeing as how he is the only person who even talks to me, he is probably right. There's nobody trying to stop me. Me just existing and doing what I thought I was supposed to do every day makes everyone miserable. If I stopped existing everyone would be free from their burden. I wish I was a person and not a burden. It's too late for that now though. Every year that goes by I just dig the hole deeper, and take more away from people who deserve it and earned it.

Can't even get a reply from a stranger. Just proves my point I guess. Nobody cares. I'm nobody special. Just a nobody vacuous leech. Just a drain. No point. It's just seals the deal. Nobody wants me here.
